concept: An interactive 3D landscape that mirrors the creator’s journey, framing a sleek, dark‑mode portfolio.

drawing.reading: A circular scene depicting mountains, a river, and a sun within a disc.

elements.name: AnimatedLandscape
elements.motion: slow parallax rotation and gentle depth shift reacting to scroll and mouse movement
elements.render: A low‑poly, dark‑themed 3D landscape rendered as a glowing disc, with silhouetted mountain ridges, a winding river and a subtle sun, using deep charcoal with teal accent highlights.

elements.name: KeyPoints
elements.render: A dark glass‑styled card area containing large single‑word achievement tags in the accent coral color, spaced evenly across the rectangle.

summary: A premium dark‑themed portfolio that opens with an immersive 3D landscape reacting to scroll and mouse, followed by concise achievement cards and classic portfolio sections.
audience: Tech recruiters, potential clients, and fellow developers seeking a high‑impact showcase of skills and accomplishments.

sections.name: HeroSection
sections.purpose: Introduce the creator with the animated 3D landscape and a bold tagline.

sections.name: AboutSection
sections.purpose: Brief bio, mission statement, and personal photo.

sections.name: ProjectsSection
sections.purpose: Showcase selected projects with screenshots and short descriptions.

sections.name: HighlightsSection
sections.purpose: Display key achievements (e.g., hackathons won) as single‑word cards.

sections.name: ContactSection
sections.purpose: Invite visitors to get in touch via a contact form and social links.

signature: A scroll‑responsive, low‑poly 3D landscape embedded in the hero that subtly morphs with mouse movement.
